items.title: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
items.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

items.title: Six shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
items.description: Another 28 people are injured in the southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

items.title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in attack by suspected Palestinian gunmen in West Bank
items.description: The two attackers were shot dead after a gun battle outside Hebron, four days before Israel's general election.

items.title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
items.description: Ukraine and Russia have not confirmed the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

items.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
items.description: Issues remain with the network used by the Ukrainian military, sources say, after repeated denials of a deliberate slowdown.

items.title: PSG v Lyon moved as Paris prepares for more protests
items.description: Paris St-Germain's Ligue 1 match against Lyon at the Parc des Princes is pushed back 24 hours as the French capital prepares for another weekend of protests.

items.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn
items.description: Once the world's largest producer of mink pelts, the nation's industry has declined in recent years.
